forum.best_answer_content:

forum.content_text:
I have the latest version of STM32CubeIDE for Mac with an Apple Silicon (2.1.1).

From time to time, I get the message

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2ef340c9-b36b-41d1-99f6-b79e4834d8f6.jpg)

When I check the program informations, it confirms that I have the correct version (Apple Silicon).

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e8f9ba76-9ce7-4458-9f14-80430dcda36a.jpg)

I think the problem is caused by Eclipse (version 4.33), which is out of date.

Is there an upcoming update for STM32CubeIDE with the ARM version of Eclipse?
forum.author: FRAUBRY
